item.title: Marko Marosi joins Tranmere Rovers on emergency one-week loan from Port Vale
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm goalkeeper Marko Marosi has joined on an emergency one-week loan from League One club Port Vale. Marosi, 32, has made seven appearances for Vale this season, including five in the league. He can count Wigan Athletic, Doncaster Rovers, Coventry City and Plymouth Argyle among his former clubs. Marosi will wear the No.33 shirt.

item.title: Gillingham 2-1 Tranmere Rovers: Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Gillingham 2-1 Tranmere Rovers Gillingham started the match as the team on top, and Marko Marosi, signed on a one-week emergency loan from Port Vale, made several early saves. The hosts took the lead in the 25th minute when Ronan Hale volleyed beyond Marosi, and the assistant referee adjudged him to be onside. 1-0. item.title: Tranmere Rovers' Joe Ironside looks ahead to Crawley Town (H)

There was a good energy among the team." You can watch his full interview below.

item.title: Tranmere Rovers manager Andy Crosby previews Crawley Town (H)
item.description: Tranmere Rovers manager Andy Crosby spoke to the media ahead of our 3pm home kick-off against Crawley Town on Saturday 14th January 2026. item.title: Africa Oye sponsor Zech Obiero for the rest of the season
item.description: Tranmere Rovers are pleased to announce Africa Oyé as the business sponsor of Zech Obiero for the rest of the 2025/26 season. Africa Oyé, the UK’s largest celebration of African music and culture, takes place annually in Liverpool. Beginning in 1992 as a series of small gigs in the city centre, the event has gone from strength to strength, moving to its present Sefton Park home in 2002 to cope with demand.
